text: That's a pattern. Put it with the upload schedule and it's proof. Now tell me why he'd do it.
style: Chief Security Officer, early fifties, ex-military. Speak with a consistent South Wales (Cardiff) accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Firm, low-to-mid pitch; brisk, economical pace. Direct, dry and steady under pressure; her warmth shows only in what she chooses to notice. On the phone.
